(need confirmation, please correct if wrong) ==Using== The basic is a nice, balanced starter petal that deals a small amount of damage. The petals do not occupy the same spot, so the space among all petals decreases. == Drops == ===[[Ladybug]]=== {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Common}} !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |40.5 |9.5 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |61.8 |23.7 |4.5 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |13.6 |62.1 |21 |3.2 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} | |0.1 |44.2 |55.3 |0.4 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | | | |92.2 |7.8 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | | |19.8 |80.2 |} ==Strategy== The light is an all around viable petal. It synergizes well with [[faster]] to create high DPS builds. It serves a similar purpose to the [[Sand]] petal. The sand has higher burst damage potential due to the petals being clumped, but the light makes damage more consistent by packing the petals closer together. At rare rarities and below, sand outclasses the light in DPS. At epic and above, light far outclasses the sand. {{Zone|Garden}} *The light is useful when used with the [[faster]], dishing out insane DPS. *It suffers from having short range which can be a problem against [[hornet]]s that can shoot from a distance. Players using this must get close to mobs in order to deal damage. **The lack of health makes the light ineffective at blocking hornet missiles. *However, all but the rarest [[spider]]s have no chance of getting through a ring of lights. {{Zone|Desert}} *Light excels in desert since there are no mobs with ranged attacks. Anything that gets close is quickly decimated by a ring of clumped lights. It should be paired with the [[faster]] to increase DPS. * Players must be careful since the light has low range. It is best to have a teammate use [[web]]s to immobilize enemies making them vulnerable to lights. * Due to [[Sandstorm]]'s random movement, using lights to take them down can be difficult, but skilled players can do it. {{Zone|Ocean}} *Light has high DPS, so it's decent against [[Starfish (Mob)|Starfish]]. However, due to its lack of range, light struggles against many mobs in Ocean. *Lights can be used to squeeze ranged petals together to make aiming easier and to increase concentrated damage. This is best done with the [[Missile]] against [[Jellyfish]]. **[[Pollen]] has this same effect and is typically better due to being able to damage enemies that wander over it. {{Zone|Ant Hole & Fire Ant Burrow}} *Light can easily drain common and unusual [[Ant Hole|Ant Holes]] because of instant recharge. Against ants inside ant holes, light can quickly clear the lot as well as the queen. *It can also kill [[Fire Ant|Fire Ants]] well, but requires a good spawn when dealing with fire ants in rare [[Fire Ant Burrow|Fire Ant Burrows]] and above. {{Zone|PvP}} ====Using==== *The light is a solid DPS petal. However, it lacks burst damage which can be a problem when dealing with other flowers. Players using [[stinger]]s can often one-shot enemies. *Lights can be used to wear down the HP of high health petals or disable [[egg]]s before they have a chance to hatch. *Light's density can serve as a shield despite each individual petal being weak. This also gives it good knockback. ====Against==== *Lights can deal some serious damage but lack the burst damage other petals have. *Lights also serve as a shield, potentially blocking ranged attacks **Players should take advantage of this, using [[stinger]]s or [[missile]]s to deal damage faster. Using [[Bubble]]s can help with this. *[[Lightning]] can bypass the light's shielding effect. ==Trivia== *As a common petal, this is often considered one of the weakest. However, as a mythic, it is one of the strongest. *This has the most petals of any petal in the game with 5 petals in a mythic. ==Gallery== File:Light (Common).png|Common Light File:Light (Unusual).png|Unusual Light File:Light (Rare).png|Rare Light File:Light (Epic).png|Epic Light File:Light (Legendary).png|Legendary Light File:Light (Mythic).png|Mythic Light {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Quick-Respawn]]

The sides are about equal in length, but not quite, with the two longer sides on opposite sides and three shorter sides. == Function == {| class="article-table" |+Petal Stats ![[Rarity]] !Damage !Health !Respawn |- |Common |10 HP |110 HP | rowspan="6" |4 seconds |- |Unusual |12 HP |143 HP |- |Rare |14 HP | HP |- |Epic |17 HP |264 HP |- |Legendary |21 HP |352 HP |- |Mythic |15 HP |440 HP |} Distance from original orbit is decreased upon expansion and contraction compared to other petals. == Drops == === [[Rock (Mob)|Rock]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Common}} !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- |{{Rarity|Common}} |12.2 |2.8 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |32.7 |7.8 |1.4 | | |- |{{Rarity|Rare}} |52.3 |35.9 |7 |1 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} | |12.6 |65.7 |21.6 |0.1 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | | |0.8 |96.8 |2.4 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | | |61.5 |38.5 |} == Strategy == Rocks are decent at dealing bursts of damage, though users must be wary of their above average respawn time. A good use of the rock (and [[Heavy]]) is to put it in front of weak, long recharge petals such as the [[Stinger]] and [[Iris]]. This prevents from getting hurt, allowing them to hit their target. Rocks can be better than Heaviest in this use since their lower knockback prevents the target from getting pushed out of the way. If a rock has taken a large amount of damage, it can be best for the user to switch it out early, allowing it to recover health while the user doesn't need it. === [[Garden]] === * Rocks can deal a lot of damage against tanky mobs such as the [[Centipede]]. * It is decent at blocking [[Hornet]] missiles, though petals with a larger hitbox are better at this. === [[Desert]] === * Rocks is decent against the [[Desert Centipede]] just as it is against the normal Centipede. === [[Ocean]] === * The rock deals solid damage, but it doesn't have any other special functions beyond that. * It can be used to shield [[Stinger]]s, which are useful against [[Starfish (Mob)|Starfish]]. === [[PvP]] === * Rock has more use in PvP as a shield petal. Stinger and Iris are both powerful petals with a very low health. Rocks can shield them from attacks allowing them to deliver a devastating blow against the target. * As for protecting the player, it works against stinger and iris. It can also block projectiles such as [[Missile]]s and [[Dandelion]]s, but deathwheels will quickly shred through them. The long respawn means that once a rock is killed, it'll be a long time before it comes back into play. == Gallery == Captura de Tela (50).png|Rock in the old Petal Gallery == Trivia == * It has the third highest durability and respawn time in the game, with [[corn]] being first. **This used to be second, only surpassed by the [[Heavy]]. **When the game was first released, it had the highest durability and respawn. {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Rocks]]

Not so good at combat though.}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a petal in florr.io. It is able to heal the user and nearby teammates. == Appearance == A pink, circular petal with a dark pink outline, roughly the same size as the [[Basic]] petal. == Function ==
''Note: The "A + B" respawn format means that the petal takes A seconds to respawn and B seconds after respawning to do its special action/have its special action enabled.'' {| class="article-table" |+Petal Stats ![[Rarity]] !Damage !Health !Respawn !Heal |- |{{Rarity|Common}} |5 HP |5 HP |rowspan="6" |3.5 + 1 seconds |10 HP |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |7 HP |7 HP |13 HP |- |{{Rarity|Rare}} |9 HP |9 HP |18 HP |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} |12 HP |12 HP |24 HP |- |{{Rarity|Legendary}} |16 HP |16 HP |32 HP |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} |20 HP |20 HP |40 HP |} If the user is not at full health, the rose will spawn, orbit the flower for a second, then go towards the flower to be absorbed by it, at which point the flower will heal and the Rose respawn timer will start. If the user has full health, it will simply behave like other petals, orbiting the flower. If a nearby player is not at full health, the rose will heal them and go on respawn after being absorbed. This petal can't go outward when attacking but can go in when defending. If a rose is healing someone but they obtain full health before they absorb the rose, the rose returns to its orbit. Likewise, if multiple roses are healing someone but not all of them are needed, unnecessary ones will return to their orbit. == Drops == === [[Ladybug]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Common}} !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |20.3 |4.7 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |46.7 |12.7 |2.3 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |37.5 |49.2 |11.3 |1.6 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} | |3.1 |63.4 |33.3 |0.2 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | | |0.03 |96 |4 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | | |44.5 |55.5 |} === [[Ladybug (Dark)]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Common}} !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |40.5 |9.5 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |61.8 |23.7 |4.5 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |13.6 |62.1 |21 |3.2 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} | |0.1 |44.2 |55.3 |0.4 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | | | |92.2 |7.8 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | | |19.8 |80.2 |} == Strategy == Base healing in florr is low, so roses are an essential petal to have. They are the most powerful healing petal, having a faster heal per second than all other healing petals. In addition, they are the only healing petal able to heal teammates, so players can quickly heal dying teammates saving them. It is strongly recommended to always have at least one rose active at all times. More roses can be kept in the inventory for when more healing is needed. The main disadvantage of the rose is that healing is not constant. It comes in a burst every 4.5 seconds, which may be too slow if being chased by mobs or when poisoned. The rose is also vulnerable in the second between respawning and healing. If it dies, it won't be able to heal. The rose has the least amount of offensive capabilities of all the healing petals, barely dealing damage and not going out upon attacking. === Garden === * Roses are great for healing against hornets. It is likely that players will be far enough way for rose petals to not get destroyed before they heal. Be aware that hornet swarms can shoot rapidly enough to take down roses before they can heal! * Petals that expand upon attacking can keep dangerous mobs away from rose petals, allowing them to heal. === Desert === * All mobs in desert use body damage, which puts roses in greater danger. However, they are still likely to heal. * Scorpions are the most dangerous. Their fast speed means they may end up destroying roses before they heal, and their poison can kill a player before roses can heal them up, as opposed to constant regen petals that slow the rate of poison. === PvP === ==== Using ==== * Roses heal players the fastest but also provide the least offense. They're great for healing when away from battle, but roses leave a weak spot in any build that another player can attack for massive damage. ** Using [[Light]]s or [[Pollen]]s, which squeeze petals closer together, can counteract this weakness. * Users should be wary when their weak spot is vulnerable. ==== Against ==== * Attackers should go in for a kill when the other player's rose is facing them as this is an obvious weak spot. * [[Bubble]]s can be used to do this quickly and catch players off guard. * If a user needs to sync their own rotation to that of another player, so as to best take advantage of their weak spot, rotation modifiers ([[Faster]] or [[Yin Yang]]) can be used. * Destroying another player's rose(s) is an easy way to cripple them. ** Using a [[Dandelion]] has the same effect. == Gallery == Captura de Tela (50).png|Rose in the Petal Gallery Captura de Tela (53).png|Deathwheel with a Rose == Trivia == * For its rarity, the Rose always has the fastest healing rate. * This is one of three healing petals, the others being the [[Leaf]] and [[Yucca]]. ** The rose is the only petal that does not heal using a constant heal rate. {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Health-Based]]

It has insane damage but low durability. == Appearance == A small, black, triangular shaped petal with an even darker outline. == Function == ''In-game description: It really hurts, but its very fragile.'' {| class="article-table" |+Petal Stats ![[Rarity]] !Damage !Health !Respawn |- |Common |35 HP |2 HP |rowspan="6" |2.5 seconds |- |Unusual |46 HP |2 HP |- |Rare |63 HP |3 HP |- |Epic |84 HP |3 HP |- |Legendary |112 HP |4 HP |- |Mythic |140 HP |5 HP |} A mythic petal has 3 stingers forming a triangle. == Drops == === [[Bee]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Common}} !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |20.3 |4.7 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |46.7 |12.7 |2.3 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |37.5 |49.2 |11.3 |1.6 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} | |3.1 |63.4 |33.3 |0.2 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | | |0.03 |96 |4 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | | |44.5 |55.5 |} == Strategy == Stingers deal devastating damage to anything they hit. Higher rarities will one shot most enemies. However, their relatively long respawn keeps the DPS fairly low, except for the mythic variety. Their low health means that other petals can destroy them easily too. === [[Garden]] === * Stinger's low respawn means that it struggles against hordes of enemies. However, it is perhaps the best petal at dealing with a single mob quickly. Stinger spam can take down moderate groups of hornets and is great is a legendary or mythic mob spawns early as nothing else matches the burst damage of stingers ** Pairing stingers with [[Faster]]s lowers the overall damage but increases how quickly it is dealt, making it a useful combination. === [[Desert]] === * Similar strategies as garden, great for dealing damage against a single mob or handling moderate swarms. It is especially useful against [[Sandstorm]]s due to their high health. Stingers can kill a sandstorm before it has the potential to cause problems. === [[Ocean]] === * Due to their health regen, Stinger is useful against [[Starfish]]. They can one shot most of them, preventing regen. ** Having multiple stingers can counter rarer varieties that may be able to tank a hit. * Stinger is good against [[Jellyfish]] since it can quickly dispatch them before they have the chance to deal too much damage * Stinger is good against [[Crab]]s since it only needs to land one hit to kill it or deal serious damage, making the crab less likely to dodge as they tend to do. === PvP === ==== Using ==== * Since the beginning of florr, stingers have been a powerhouse in PvP. A few of them will make quick work of any flower and all players fear them. A mythic stinger deals over 400 damage at once, killing any player in one hit unless they have opted to spam [[Cactus|Cacti]], but if they decided to do that, they lack adequate damage. * The goal of a stinger user is quite simple - land a stinger on the flower to deal lethal or near lethal damage. ** [[Faster]]s can make this easier by causing stingers to move faster, making them harder to dodge or destroy ** One of the most popular builds involves stingers and [[Bubble]]s. The stingers are placed on the opposite side of the bubbles, so when the user uses their bubbles, their stringers are thrusted into any opponent with almost no way to dodge. * High health petals such as the [[Heaviest]] can be used a shield against fragile stingers ** Stinger users can also use these petals to shield their stingers * A stinger can be paired with an [[Iris]] for an inescapable combo. The stinger deals a quick hit of damage while the iris slowly deals the rest. This is an almost guaranteed kill if successful, but the attacker must land a good hit and dodge counterattacks for a few seconds. ** Hitting the player with a [[Dandelion]] beforehand prevents them from healing and escaping. ==== Against ==== * High petal density, achieved through [[Light]] or [[Pollen]] spam, can serve as a shield against stinger attacks too * If a player's stingers are killed, they are left vulnerable for a few seconds. Players can take full advantage of this, attacking the stinger user before their petals recharge. Stinger users should be wary of this and be ready to flee battle if needed. Bubbles can help with this. == Gallery == Captura de Tela (50).png|Stinger in the Petal Gallery RICKBYEST.png|A stinger being used against ants Captura de Tela (92).png|A stinger in the old ? zone, the former hardest zone in the game. == Trivia == *Mythic stingers are frequently referred to as tringers due to there being three and them forming a triangle shape *They were originally most frequently obtained from [[Hornet]]s, but this was changed on February 19, 2020, when Hornets no longer dropped Stingers (they drop [[Missile|Missiles]] now) *This petal has the highest burst damage potential of any petal, with a mythic stinger dealing up to 411 damage. **Even a [[Level]] 45 player will need 5 mythic [[Cactus|cacti]], 6 legendary cacti, or 8 epic cacti to withstand a hit against a mythic stinger {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]]

''Note: The "A + B" respawn format means that the petal takes A seconds to respawn and B seconds after respawning to do its special action/have its special action enabled.'' {| class="article-table" |+Petal Stats ![[Rarity]] !Damage !Health !Respawn |- |Common |colspan="3"|Doesn't Spawn |- |Unusual |39 HP |1 HP |rowspan="4" |1 + 0.5 seconds |- |Rare |54 HP |2 HP |- |Epic |72 HP |2 HP |- |Legendary |96 HP |3 HP |- |Mythic |120 HP |4 HP |0.5 + 0.1 seconds |} When attacking, travels in a straight line for 15 tiles or until it hits something, then disappears. Damage and durability are same regardless of whether the petal is fired or not. The Mythic variant of this petal can change direction to hit enemies or players to a certain degree when it is fired (i.e. it is homing). == Drops == === [[Hornet]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |4.7 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |12.7 |2.3 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |49.2 |11.3 |1.6 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} |3.1 |63.4 |33.3 |0.2 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | |0.03 |96 |4 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | |44.5 |55.5 |} == Strategy == Compared to the [[Stinger]], missiles have worse health and far worse damage, being one shot by pretty much any petal. However, they have ranged capabilities and a much faster respawn. Missiles can deal heavy damage to enemies from afar. However, it can be liability in close quarters combat since missiles will fire upon attacking instead of expanding in orbit. Low health is mostly mitigated by fast respawn. Stingers also have low health and die in one or two hits to most attacks. Missiles do too but come back much faster than stingers, making them much more useful as a powerful defensive wall. Using [[Light]] or [[Pollen]], missiles can be clumped together to form a shotgun with a concentrated, deadly attack. Using [[Yin Yang]]s can fix the direction of the missiles, making aiming easier. Using [[Faster]] can make missiles harder to aim but skilled players can use it to fire missiles at a target more often. === [[Garden]] === * Missile is good in ranged and close combat alike. ** Missiles are good at taking out [[Hornet]]s or other foes from a distance. This can be useful in avoiding close confrontation. However, it requires precise aim and hornet missiles could potentially take out flower missiles. ** Their fast respawn makes missiles good as a last minute shield that is up most of the time. Their high damage means most mobs will be one shot. However, dense swarms can overwhelm missiles. === [[Desert]] === * Just like Garden, missile is a versatile petal ** For ranged combat, it is best used against [[Sandstorm]]s to avoid troublesome close combat with them. It can also be used to snipe down fleeing [[Desert Centipedes]] or to assist teammates against mob swarms without risking damage. ** For close combat, missiles are a risky but effective method. Being unable to attack without firing them, it requires the user to get right in a mob's face to deal damage, and mobs in desert have high body damage. Missiles are best used as a defensive petal in this regard rather than as something used to go on the offensive. === [[Ocean]] === * Missiles are one of the best petals in Ocean. ** Missiles can kill [[Jellyfish]] without getting into their range. This requires some aim, but the jellyfish hitbox is relatively large, so not as much precision is needed. Most jellyfish will die in 1-2 hits. *** Squeezing the missiles together with [[Light]]s or [[Pollen]]s can help as can using multiple missiles ** Missiles have the burst damage to one shot [[Starfish (Mob)|Starfish]]. Even if they don't, they'll be left with low health, low enough that they can be shot again to kill them or rammed to death. ** Aiming is required, but Missiles can deal hefty damage to [[Crab]]s and [[Shell (Mob|Shells]]. ** In addition to serving as a projectile, missiles serve as a last line of defense against ramming mobs that deal heavy damage. === [[PvP]] === ==== Using ==== * Skilled players can snipe others from far away using missiles. However, it'll struggle to get through players with high health petals or high petal density. * Using [[Bubble]]s with missiles is effective. The bubbles can be used to boost a player into someone else while the missiles serve as a ramming force, dealing massive damage. Using bubbles makes it easy to bypass a defensive petal shield, but attackers should be wary of any high damage petals opponents have since they'll have to pass through those. ** This strategy is good on the defense too. Right after using the bubbles, the player can fire their missiles. The sudden momentum boost causes the missiles to be fired behind the player, dealing damage to chasers. * Pairing missiles with [[Light]]s or [[Pollen]]s can cram them closer together, creating a tighter bullet field or shield that is more effective on both offense and defense. ==== Against ==== * If the missile user if far away, they can be dodged. * Use high health petals or high petal density to block incoming missiles * Missiles cannot extend out like other petals can, but they will fire, so they're still a threat at moderate range. * Try to use [[Bubble]]s to quickly attack a missile user right after they have fired them. * Use [[Salt]] to punish missile players with reflected damaged. == Trivia == * The missile has the second lowest health out of any petal, with only the [[Bubble]] being lower. ** The unusual missile is tied with the bubble in terms of health. * The missile is one of a few petals that has a change in respawn depending on rarity. ** Interestingly, the bubble is also one of these petals. {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Aiming]] [[Category:Debuffs]]

By right clicking, the user can propel their flower in the opposite direction of the bubble. == Appearance == A light blue, circular petal. A lighter ring surrounds the outside of the petal as well as a lighter dot in the upper right of the petal. == Function == ''Note: The "A + B" respawn format means that the petal takes A seconds to respawn and B seconds after respawning to do its special action/have its special action enabled.'' {| class="article-table" |+Petal Stats ![[Rarity]] !Damage !Health !Respawn |- |{{Rarity|Common}} | rowspan="6" |0 HP | rowspan="6" |1 HP |5.5 + 0.5 seconds |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |4.5 + 0.5 seconds |- |{{Rarity|Rare}} |3.5 + 0.5 seconds |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} |2.5 + 0.5 seconds |- |{{Rarity|Legendary}} |1.5 + 0.5 seconds |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} |0.5 + 0.5 seconds |} Upon right clicking, propels the player in the opposite direction of where it currently is in relation to the flower. Stacks with other bubbles, but only if next to each other. In other words, bubbles on opposite sides cancel each other out. It also pushes the movement of other petals forward. == Drops == === [[Bubble (Mob)|Bubble]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Common}} !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |20.3 |4.7 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |46.7 |12.7 |2.3 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |37.5 |49.2 |11.3 |1.6 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} | |3.1 |63.4 |33.3 |0.2 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | | |0.03 |96 |4 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | | |44.5 |55.5 |} == Strategy == On its own, the bubble has no offensive capabilities. It can, however, be used to make a quick approach on an enemy, catching them off guard and minimizing damage taken. For defense, bubbles allow the user to escape their enemy faster than they can chase them. Bubble is best used in PvP since its advantages are best suited to taking out players. Outrunning a mob swarm does not get rid of the problem, and the bubble can't deal any damage. [[Faster]]s can make the bubble harder to aim but also increase the frequency at which the desired direction is obtainable. === [[Garden]] === * The Bubble can be used to get out of tight situations such as a [[Hornet]] swarm cornering the user or outrunning a [[Spider]] that's about to kill the user. Other petals must be used to actually deal with the problem though. === [[Desert]] === * In Desert, the most common strategy is to hunker down in one spot and spam [[Web]]s. This makes bubble a liability to have since it'll push the user out of the web fortress. Don't use Bubble. === [[Ocean]] === * Similarly to Garden, bubble can be used to escape a horde of mobs such as a [[Jellyfish]] swarm. * With well-timed firing (right after using the bubbles), bubbles in conjunction with [[Missile]]s can be used to concentrate the missile fire behind the user, dealing heavy damage as the user flees. === [[PvP]] === ==== Using ==== * The Bubble allows the user to easily catch up to other flowers without a bubble. This also means the user can easily run from flowers with a bubble. * Using multiple bubbles can allow the user to boost themselves farther, reaching distant areas. This helps in chasing as well as escaping. * Bubbles are best used not only for surviving, but can also be for ramming other players if used properly. * As bubble petals activate with right-click, the user can propel themselves in unwanted directions if they have to defend. To avoid it, the user has to stop defending when the bubble petals are about to respawn. Since defending is a great way to survive some situations, bubble can become a liability. * The petal has very very low HP meaning it can easily be destroyed before the user even gets to boost with it. * Equip bubbles in adjacent slots to boost their effect. Do not equip them in opposing slots. Using [[Light]] or [[Pollen]], thus squeezing them closer, enhances the bubbles' effect. === Against === * Although it may be hard to catch a bubble user, the bubble itself provides no offensive power. This creates a weak spot in the build that can be attacked for massive damage. * If a player attempts to ram with the Bubble, an Instant-DPS build that consists of [[Stinger|Stingers]] and healing petals will suffice to drive them away or even kill them. * Ranged petals can be used to kill a Bubble from afar. [[Peas]] are best for this since they spray rather than concentrate their power in a few projectiles. The bubble's low health means it'll die anyway. == Gallery == Bubble (Common).png|Common Bubble Bubble (Unusual).png|Unusual Bubble Bubble (Rare).png|Rare Bubble Bubble (Epic).png|Epic Bubble Bubble (Legendary).png|Legendary Bubble Bubble (Mythic).png|Mythic Bubble == Trivia == * This is the first petal that cannot directly deal damage, the others being [[Antennae]] and [[Cutter]]. ** However, the Cutter has indirect damage by increasing body damage. * This is the first and only petal that provides a movement boost. * Bubble petals are purely for movement boost only, and as such, no damage stat is displayed. {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Buffs]]

{{Petal Template Infobox |image1 = Pollen.png |title1 = Pollen|caption1 = |rarity = |dropped_by = *[[Bee]]|damage = *'''Common:''' Doesn't Spawn *'''Unusual:''' 9 *'''Rare:''' 13 *'''Epic:''' 17 *'''Legendary:''' 22 *'''Mythic:''' 28|durability = *'''Common:''' Doesn't Spawn *'''Unusual:''' 7 *'''Rare:''' 9 *'''Epic:''' 12 *'''Legendary:''' 16 *'''Mythic:''' 20|special = Drops and lingers on the ground for 5 seconds upon left/right click|description=Asthmatics beware|cooldown_time=1 + 0.5 (0.3 + 0.5 for mythic)}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a petal in florr.io. It is much like a [[Light]] petal, except that it has the ability to drop and stay on the ground. == Appearance == It looks much like the Light, as it is the same shape and size, but it is yellow instead of white. The outlines of each pollen are dark yellow. == Function == ''Note: The "A + B" respawn format means that the petal takes A seconds to respawn and B seconds after respawning to do its special action/have its special action enabled.'' {| class="article-table" |+Petal Stats ![[Rarity]] !Damage !Health !Respawn |- |{{Rarity|Common}} |colspan="3"|Doesn't Spawn |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |9 HP |7 HP |rowspan="4" |1 + 0.5 seconds |- |{{Rarity|Rare}} |13 HP |9 HP |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} |17 HP |12 HP |- |{{Rarity|Legendary}} |22 HP |16 HP |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} |28 HP |20 HP |0.3 + 0.5 seconds |} A rare pollen has 2 petals, and a pollen of rarity epic or higher has 3 petals. If there are multiple petals, they do not occupy the same spot, so the space among all petals decreases. Upon left or right-clicking, all of Pollen will drop from the flower and stay stationary, damaging enemies that make contact in it, as well as blocking [[Hornet]] missiles. Left or right clicking will scatter them or cluster together respectively before staying still. Upon being dropped on the ground, pollen will stay there for 5 seconds. == Drops == === [[Bee]] === {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- | {{Rarity|Common}} |1.9 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |5.3 |0.9 | | |- | {{Rarity|Rare}} |26.4 |4.7 |0.6 | |- |{{Rarity|Epic}} |25.1 |59.8 |15 |0.08 |- | {{Rarity|Legendary}} | |3.8 |94.5 |1.6 |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} | | |72.3 |27.7 |} == Strategy == Pollen DPS is lower than DPS based petals, but unlike other petals, its DPS is constant. This is because it can lay petals down at a constant rate; it does not need to immediately hit a mob to deal damage, as a mob may wander over the petal later. This is useful in creating a defensive trail or shield. It is very difficult for players and mobs to pursue a fleeing pollen user, though the front side will be left vulnerable. Compared to the [[Light]], a petal similar to it, this petal excels at defense while the Light is better on offense and as a general purpose petal. === [[Garden]] === * [[Hornet]]s stray far away from the flower, so taking them out with Pollen requires the user to flee. This can cause them to run into hornets on their front side where they will be left vulnerable. * Pollen is near useless against non aggressive mobs. With no way to control their movement, the user must hope the mob runs into the pollen or get extremely close to the mob, risking body damage. * Pollen is extremely useful against [[Spider]]s. The player can stand still and create a defensive ring that is nearly impossible to penetrate, especially since spiders have low HP. This is more effective if other players do the same. It is wise for players to keep several Pollens in their inventory, as they will come in handy at Wave 16, an only Spider wave. === [[Desert]] === * All mobs in desert deal damage using their body, so a pursuing mob will have to pass through a bunch of pollen petals. **However, if the mobs overwhelm the pollen and force the user to flee, they will be left wide open to head on attacks where they have little protection. * Pollen is not very useful against Sandstorms due to their random movement. === [[Ocean]] === * Pollen is still effective in ocean but is not as dominant as in other game modes. ** [[Jellyfish]] can be taken out using pollen, but the user must flee due to the jellyfish's range. Thankfully jellyfish are slow, so a head on attack can be avoided. ** Pollen is good at depleting a [[Starfish (Mob)|Starfish]] to half health, but it cannot kill the Starfish afterward since it will then flee from the player. Other petals must be used to finish a starfish off. === [[PvP]] === ==== Using ==== * Pollen can be used to slow down enemies that try to chase you. While a single Pollen does not do much, enemies that consecutively touches them will eventually have their health wear down. * This is a great defensive petal allowing the user to run away from players while the pollen left behind on the ground will damage them. ** Although pollen's knockback is low, repeatedly running into it will hinder a pursuer's movement, allowing the user to get away. The pursuer can also try to dodge the pollen, but this will slow them down. ==== Against ==== * It's a good idea to follow a different pathway than the trail of pollen on the ground to avoid taking damage. * Pollen itself is quite weak, though the chaser's petals will not be able to destroy a trail of it. It is, however, useful in close range combat where pollen is not as useful. *Salt will reflect damage dealt by pollen back to the user. == Gallery == Captura de Tela (135).png|Pollen is normally used to kill Mobs with a good distance from them. Captura_de_Tela_(132).png|Pollen used as a shield Captura de Tela (186).png|Pollen in legacy PG Pollen (Common).png|Common Pollen Pollen (Unusual).png|Unusual Pollen Pollen (Rare).png|Rare Pollen Pollen (Epic).png|Epic Pollen Pollen (Legendary).png|Legendary Pollen Pollen (Mythic).png|Mythic Pollen == Trivia == * This, along with [[Stinger]], [[Pearl]] and [[Claw]] is the petal tied for second with the most individual petals. ** [[Light]] is the first, with up to 5 individual petals. ** It, along with [[Light]] is also the only petal where the individual petals do not occupy the same spot, thus decreasing the distance between petals * This is one of three petals to stick to the ground, the other being [[Web]]. {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Triple]] [[Category:Quick-Respawn]]

Dandelion disables this, allowing lower DPS builds to finish the job. For legendary or mythic starfish, a dandelion is almost required, so make sure at least one player has them. ** A starfish under the influence of a dandelion does not retreat since they can't heal. It will not add poison onto the pre-existing value. ==Drops== ===Mobs=== *[[Scorpion]] ===Obtaining=== *Farm Scorpions in the [[Desert]]. **Later waves spawn more Scorpions, and higher rarity ones. **Waves that only spawn Scorpions are great for farming Pincers. *Do not farm in [[Garden]] or [[Ocean]], the mobs there do not drop Pincer. ==Strategy== Pincer's poison effect is unremarkable, being outclassed by the [[Iris]], although it does have a faster respawn. It's best used against high rarities in conjunction with [[Web]]s to cripple them. ===[[Ocean]]=== *The pincer is ironically useful against the [[Crab]]. Stacks with other healing petals. ==Drops== ===[[Fire Ant]]=== {| class="article-table" |+Drop Rates !Mob Rarity !{{Rarity|Unusual}} !{{Rarity|Rare}} !{{Rarity|Epic}} !{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- |{{Rarity|Common}} |4.7 | | | |- |{{Rarity|Unusual}} |12.7 |2.3 | | |- |{{Rarity|Rare}} |49.2 |11.3 |1.6 | |- | {{Rarity|Epic}} | colspan="4" rowspan="3" |Doesn't Spawn |- |{{Rarity|Legendary}} |- |{{Rarity|Mythic}} |} ==Strategy== The Yucca petal itself is rather weak. The Yucca only heals the user when they are in defensive position, so Yuccas are best used alongside petals that work fine when in the defensive position. For example, Pollen and Eggs function well in the defensive position. If using a build that requires the attack position (such as DPS builds, peashooter builds), players should use Roses instead of Yuccas. The main advantage of Yuccas compared to Roses is that they provide better defense against mobs. Because of this, a full Yucca build is superior to a full Rose build, since a full Rose build has virtually no defense. A strategy is for players to keep a full Yucca build in their secondary slots and put it on when at low HP. It will heal nearly as fast as a full rose build, but players will be more able to defend themselves. Another strategy is to use a build with all Yuccas except for one Salt. This build can quickly regenerate, has decent defense, and can kill ranged mobs through reflected damage. Note: Legendary Leaf has better stats than Epic Yucca, so if you don’t have full Legendary Yucca, you should use Legendary Leaves instead. ===[[Garden]]=== *The Yucca-Salt build is good at surviving late waves in Garden. With enough Yuccas, players can outheal even fairly large swarms of Hornets, especially if the player is skilled at dodging hornet missiles. The Salt deals enough damage back to Hornets to eventually kill them. ** One player in a squad can use a Yucca-Salt build and attract the fire of Hornets, while another can use a high DPS build to easily destroy the distracted hornets. *The Yucca-Lightning build is very good against hornets, since when a lightning petal is hit by a hornet missile, it can damage several hornets at once. Yuccas are useful in this build because players can damage hornets even while in the defensive position. ===[[Desert]]=== *Yucca doesn't have major strengths in Desert. Ironically, Desert is the only place where Yuccas can be obtained. * ===[[Ocean]]=== *If a player is using petals that work well in the defensive position, Yuccas could be used instead of Roses when dealing with Jellyfish. Roses can be destroyed by Jellyfish lightning, which would prevent their healing, but Yuccas will heal regardless. *The Yucca-Salt build could be used to kill Jellyfish as long as the user avoids a large Jellyfish swarm. * ===[[PvP]]=== ====Using ==== *Yuccas can be used as a defensive petal and a healing petal. *Keep an all Yucca or Yucca-Salt build in your secondary slot. * ====Against==== *Take advantage of the fact that your opponent will need to defend in order to heal. Try to stay at attacking range and force your opponent to choose between attacking and healing. * The Dandelion can prevent the healing effect of the Yucca. * ==Gallery== ==Trivia== *The Yucca is very similar to the Leaf, in both appearance and function. * {{Petals}} [[Category:Petals]] [[Category:Health-Based]]

== Spawning ==
Scorpions spawn in [[Desert]] from [[wave]] 3 onwards with the exception of waves 13, 19 and 20.

===Looting===
Diggers, unlike the vast majority of mobs in florr.io, ''cannot be damaged by the player.'' If you want to get loot from the Digger, it is recommended to lure in enemies so the Digger will attack them. If the Digger is low, have enemies follow you and ram into the Digger. When the Digger dies, it will drop a Cutter of any rarity, dependent on the rarity of the Digger itself.
==Tips==
*The Digger is actually quite useful if you happen to find it in later waves, as Legendary / Mythic mobs can pose a big threat, and the Digger will attempt to destroy it.
*There isn't much of a reason to use enemies to kill the Digger, as it is helpful, not harmful, other than to gain it’s rather useful drops.
*Utilize the Digger as much as you can when it appears, as it might not appear for a long time.
*You can use leaves to heal the Digger. This can make it attack again after it stops attacking. This is especially useful for epic, legendary, and mythic diggers, as they have lots of health, so they can be used tactically to help aid your squad in later waves.
*Diggers have massive FoV, so they become aggressive to mobs that are even quite far away. This can be used at the end of a wave to track down passive mobs that were not killed during the main battle in the middle of the wave.

==Trivia==
*Although it doesn’t make much sense, Diggers can be healed by leaves, in the same way that flowers can heal other flowers with roses and dahlias.
*The Digger is one of the few mobs that is an ally.
**The Ants and Beetles spawned from Eggs are considered allies. The same goes for the Sandstorms spawned from Sticks.
***All ally mobs (also known as friendly mobs) can be healed by leaves, which determines whether or not they are allies.
*The Digger is an obvious reference to [https://Digdig.io digdig.io], a game made by the same developers of florr.io.
*Diggers can be slowed by a Legendary or Mythic Spider's webs.
*Diggers flee when at low health. The code does not account for the borders of the map, meaning that diggers often continuously bounce off of the map’s border when at low health.
*Common and unusual diggers do not exist. This is because that rarity of ant hole cannot be entered.
